mechanism: Pyrazinamide can cause hyperuricemia and acute gout, while telmisartan may reduce urate excretion, increasing risk of gout precipitation; additionally, pyrazinamide may have minor effects on renal function affecting telmisartan clearance.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and clinical signs of gout; consider allopurinol prophylaxis if indicated; monitor renal function periodically during concurrent use.
